objective: Turn verified TaskPebble facts into platform-native content drafts for a technical personal brand without adding unsupported project claims.
audience_hypothesis: people interested in practical software and AI projects

creative_direction.story_priority: Lead with a relatable problem or payoff rather than a project-name introduction.
creative_direction.proof_priority: Show or reference evidence-backed implementation details when useful.
style_notes: Avoid fake urgency, fake controversy, and guaranteed-performance language.
Prefer a concrete problem, build decision, failure, demonstration, or payoff over a generic feature list.
Creative direction may change pacing, framing, visuals, hook, and ordering but must not alter the meaning of verified project claims.

targets.desired_output: concept, title options, hook, and concise outline
